sample_unit: clinical safety questions (plus 12 benchmark extraction cases)

links.outcome: Medical accuracy of graph-grounded answers versus conventional RAG on clinical safety questions
links.effect: GraphRAG accuracy 0.545 vs 0.443 for conventional RAG (difference 0.102, p=0.04); GraphRAG gave the better answer 66.7% of the time.
links.quote: For clinical question answering, we found that GraphRAG outperformed conventional RAG in terms of medical accuracy (0.545 vs. 0.443, absolute difference of 0.102, p = 0.04).

unlisted_practices: Multi-agent Extractor-Critic workflow with quality checks for building a pharmacotherapy knowledge graph from unstructured text
Graph traversal retrieval with safety-directed re-ranking for drug safety verification

screen.reason: The study develops and tests a multi-agent GraphRAG framework as a retrieval grounding safeguard for LLMs against baseline standard RAG / zero-shot generation on pharmacotherapy safety verification benchmarks.
